pr2.title: research: real-artifact composition v2 with explicit execution limits
pr2.body:
## Problem and result

Individually accepted proofs and signatures can concern different inputs, subjects, actions, executions, policies or domains. This research compares component-only authorization with explicit cross-artifact obligations using retained native zkIE artifacts and genuine laboratory EIP-712 signatures.

The positive claim is limited to a pinned public MatMul recomputation under a laboratory policy. A complete external WYRIWE -> zkIE -> judgment -> execution chain remains NOT IMPLEMENTED. Offline domains, laboratory authority and signed local observations do not establish external admission or historical execution. No upstream vulnerability, cryptographic soundness theorem, scientific priority or certification is claimed.

## Original v2 evidence

- Main `18a5916098addf6447700ed95441125bfa7079c3` contains v1 `ea89871064e98a67b6ba01c836d498bee89aa437`; main is unchanged.
- Two retained 380-byte native proofs, separate-process verification and full arithmetic recomputation; ten actual laboratory signature artifacts and Keccak commitments.
- 26 scenarios, 20 tests in normal/repeat/Python -O. Component-only control falsely authorizes 18/25 negatives; composition authorizes 0/25 with four UNVERIFIABLE outcomes.
- The frozen original run at `ba889271bef7cb3d2eed00067a12064689bfb627` remains 18 KILLED / 2 SURVIVED / 0 CRASHED. One unavailable historical-execution integration is UNVERIFIABLE and unexecuted.

## Survivor audit

Both original survivors are non-equivalent mutations with masked original witnesses. For native enforcement, input and provenance bindings independently rejected the original wrong-input case. For artifact type enforcement, signer authority independently rejected the receipt-as-judgment case.

The follow-up adds isolated witnesses with six genuinely generated laboratory signatures. An explicitly corrupted proof fails only inference; a genuine LabReceipt signed by the judgment-role key fails only artifact type. Removing each exact original source check changes REFUTED to VERIFIED; restoring it restores REFUTED. Positive controls remain VERIFIED. Mutant source hashes match the original run. No verifier logic changes.

- Follow-up: 2 KILLED, 0 SURVIVED, 0 CRASHED, 0 NOT_APPLIED, 0 UNVERIFIABLE.
- 7 additional tests pass normal/repeat/-O; both targeted tests fail by assertion under their mutants and pass after restoration. Audit snapshots are identical across modes and match on Linux CI.
- Fresh public checkout `653b8e92e56afb99797c04b1c616a6d7fb3555e9` passes native build and two native tests, original 20 tests in three modes, all new controls and all 755 inventory checks.
- All three GitHub workflows passed for both push and PR at this SHA. All 496 protected source/fixture/evidence/test/native files remain byte-identical to the original v2 commit.

See [survivor audit](https://github.com/pipavlo82/verifiable-ai-guarantee-composition/blob/653b8e92e56afb99797c04b1c616a6d7fb3555e9/research/V2_SURVIVOR_AUDIT.md), [original v2 report](https://github.com/pipavlo82/verifiable-ai-guarantee-composition/blob/653b8e92e56afb99797c04b1c616a6d7fb3555e9/research/V2_REAL_ARTIFACT_REPORT.md) and [Linux CI](https://github.com/pipavlo82/verifiable-ai-guarantee-composition/actions/runs/38969191251). Fresh execution and CI are reproducibility evidence, not independent human review. Keep this PR draft; no merge is requested or authorized.

pr3.title: research: scoped real evidence chain v3 and explicit blockers
pr3.body:
V3 independently replays the preserved v2 results and adds externally published Nostr/EIP-712 artifacts, native zkIE replay, a typed claim-obligation planner and a local execution record checked through ReceiptOS/Crystal.

Status: **PARTIAL_CHAIN_VERIFIED**. Four narrow positive claims do not establish a complete external WYRIWE → zkIE → judgment → execution chain. Exact missing admission, authority, binding and execution evidence is documented with an executable acquisition plan.

Validation: 36 scenarios, 19 tests per normal/repeat/optimized run, three external signatures cross-checked by Node/Python, 14 isolated source mutations killed and zero survived/crashed. The same-evidence component baseline falsely authorizes 21/32 negative/unsupported requests; explicit composition authorizes 0/32. Six unavailable integration boundaries remain outside mutation coverage. Historical v2 18/2 and follow-up 2/0 evidence remain unchanged.

Includes the formal model, prior-art analysis, academic paper draft, source/byte locks, raw command logs and pinned CI. No upstream vulnerability, general security guarantee or novelty claim is made.

This branch is based on unmerged draft PR #2 at 653b8e92e56afb99797c04b1c616a6d7fb3555e9; the main diff therefore includes that dependency. Review v3-only changes from that SHA. Keep this PR draft; do not merge automatically.
